name: Self-serve signup
context: Landing page from paid search and organic. Signup form has 6 fields (name, email, password, company, role, phone). Email verification is a 6-digit code. Onboarding is 5 screens. Users land in an empty workspace. Audience: ops and RevOps managers at 50-500 person companies.

steps.name: signup_form
steps.description: Clicked primary CTA, saw signup form

name: Free trial with checkout
context: Pricing page to 14-day trial. Trial requires a credit card up front. Checkout form has card + billing address. Audience: sales leaders at mid-market companies; most arrive from G2 and comparison pages.
